# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 and API docs** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and packages compiler-generated XML documentation with managed assemblies. HarfBuzzSharp binding generation now follows the bundled native source; code using corrected or removed enum members may need migration.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed** — The misspelled CCC133 member is corrected to CCC132, retaining numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is unavailable** — The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags required by your application instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and includes upstream m154 bug and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **XML documentation ships with NuGet packages** — Managed package assemblies now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API prose maintained alongside the C# surface. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HarfBuzz bindings follow the bundled native source** — Generated bindings now track the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia while omitting unsupported callback-heavy families. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp generation now follows the bundled native source, keeping supported bindings synchronized while correcting the CCC132 enum name and removing aggregate flag masks.
